title: Shopping is moving to AI agents, and our store must be ready for them
summary: Amazon: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping, spending 50% more. NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery. Walmart added agent spend limits; Target built holiday around an AI assistant. Memory shortage may last years (Samsung, SK Hynix).

points.headline: AI assistants now drive discovery and higher spend at scale
points.detail: 400M customers used Alexa for Shopping and spend 50% more; NIQ finds 55% use AI in discovery. Our product content and catalog must be readable and purchasable by assistants.

points.headline: Retailers are building agent trust and holding discovery in-house
points.detail: Walmart added spending limits for agent purchases; Target centers holiday on its AI assistant. We should plan agent checkout controls and check how our listings appear to agents.

points.headline: Memory shortage keeps PC demand weak and costs high
points.detail: Samsung and SK Hynix expect shortages for years; Intel AI PCs sell while the wider market shrinks. We should plan pricing, inventory and AI PC focus accordingly.

points.headline: Walmart's longer Black Friday window pulls demand earlier
points.detail: Walmart stretches Black Friday and Cyber Monday events to 14 days from 10. We should check our deal calendar and price-matching against it.
